sources.citation: Blench, Roger. n.d. The Maya [Yendang] languages: wordlists collected by Barau Kato and Zachariah Yoder, analysis by Roger Blench. Unpublished manuscript, 15 pp. (Glottolog ref 158487; open scan on archive.org as 'Comparatie Yandang Dictionary')

sources.note: Nothing on stress or tone. Contains Bali, Kpasham, Yoti and Yandang wordlists only; Kumba appears solely in the classification line p. ii: 'Bali-Kpasham | Waka-Yendang-Yoti | Teme | Gengle-Kugama-Kumba.. there is no published evidence for such a classification'. States 'The Yandang languages as a whole are barely known.'
